name: resume-map
symptom: After play-resume, the map was mostly black and terrain appeared as a thin strip above the control panel.
cause: Radar and programmatic recentering changed the tile view rectangle but retained GPU camera offset, target and velocity, so the whole-map texture remained displaced.
fix: Reset GPU pan offset, target and velocity whenever the main RadarMap explicitly centers or handles a valid left click.
regression: ui-resume-map creates a camera offset through real edge input, clicks the radar map, and requires both camera offsets to return to zero before a fresh passive frame.
